title: Oven Jerk Chicken
description: Chicken thighs marinated in a fiery, fragrant blend of scotch bonnet, allspice, thyme, garlic and scallions, then roasted until charred.
equipment: Rimmed baking sheet with a rack

image.alt: Dark spiced jerk chicken thighs on a sheet pan with lime wedges

ingredients.item: bone-in, skin-on chicken thighs and drumsticks

steps.text: Blend the green onions, chile, garlic, ginger, allspice, thyme, cinnamon, brown sugar, soy sauce, lime juice, oil and salt into a thick paste. Wear gloves or wash your hands well after handling the chile.
Cut a few deep slashes in each piece of chicken and rub the marinade all over and into the cuts. Refrigerate for at least {time 4 hr notimer}, or overnight.
Heat the oven to {temp 425F oven}. Set a rack on the baking sheet and arrange the chicken on it skin side up.
Roast until the skin is dark and charred in spots and the meat near the bone reads {temp 175F internal}, {time 35-40 min}.
For extra char, broil for {time 2-3 min} at the end, watching closely. Rest for {time 5 min} and serve with rice and peas and lime wedges.

notes: Scotch bonnets are very hot. Use half, seeded, for a milder jerk.
On a grill, cook over medium indirect heat with the lid closed, turning occasionally, for about 35 minutes.
